adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when sharing is enabled it returns the raw `fetch(...)` Response object (no `json()` parsing). In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is treated as a `HubspotToken` (`const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`). This type/shape mismatch is verifiable from the diff and will break refresh logic in sharing mode; downstream code that expects token fields (and possibly persists them to `credential.key`) would receive a `Response` instead, risking corrupted/invalid stored credentials.
